indicatorContextLines.bocRate: The Bank of Canada held the overnight rate at 2.25% on June 10, a second consecutive hold paired with its Monetary Policy Report.
indicatorContextLines.cpi: Headline CPI registered +2.8% YoY (May snapshot), with the formal May print scheduled for June 17; core-trim and core-median both sit at 2.0%.
indicatorContextLines.unemployment: The unemployment rate held at 6.6% in May with the employment rate at 60.7% and participation at 65.0%; average hourly wage fell 1.4% m/m to $37.24.
indicatorContextLines.housingStarts: Housing starts rose to 279,317 SAAR in May (+6.9% m/m) even as April residential building permits fell 5.5% m/m and non-residential permits fell 10.5% m/m.
indicatorContextLines.realGdp: Monthly real GDP declined 0.1% in March 2026 (released May 15); the next GDP-by-industry release covers April on June 24.

cross_references.interpretation: Manufacturing GDP -2.5% YoY (March), even as April manufacturing sales rose +4.2% m/m to $77,052.9M. Database tracks 346 active manufacturing projects ($70.0B).
Mining/quarrying/oil-gas GDP -2.1% m/m (March). Copper +35.6% YoY and iron-ore proxy +16.1% YoY against 551 active mining projects ($199.9B).
BoC held at 2.25% June 10. 1862 active rate-sensitive projects (residential/commercial/infrastructure, $284.3B) finance against the GoC curve (5Y at 3.04%).
WTI $80.58/bbl, down 11.7% w/w and 23.6% over the month. Sits above the $74-76 breakeven cluster the cross-reference engine cites for 91 active oil_gas projects ($63.2B).
Housing starts 279,317 SAAR (May, +6.9% m/m) but residential building permits -5.5% m/m. 272 active residential projects ($41.6B).
